Title: Public preview: Microsoft Copilot for Azure capability now available in Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Microsoft Copilot for Azure is an AI companion that simplifies how you can design, operate, optimize, and troubleshoot apps & infrastructure from cloud to edge. 

The public preview of the copilot capability in Azure Cosmos DB enables you to turn your data questions into Azure Cosmos DB NoSQL queries using the Azure Cosmos DB Data Explorer.    

This new capability uses the power of Azure OpenAI to increase your productivity and reduce time spent on building queries. It also provides English language explanations of the generated query, increasing interpretability and making it easier to validate the accuracy of the AI-generated query.   

Try out the new Microsoft Copilot for Azure experience in Azure Cosmos DB from the Azure Portal using Data Explorer!
